load_JSON_segment_masks: load RLE-encoded segmentation masks from a JSON file for a specific video frame and object IDs
get_valid_object_frames: get all valid frame IDs for each object in a JSON segment loader with optional minimum frame count filter
load_palettised_PNG_masks: load binary segmentation masks from palettised PNG files where each palette index represents a different object
load_multiple_PNG_masks: load multiple per-object PNG mask files from a directory structure with one folder per object ID
load_SA1B_segments: load SA1B dataset segments from a JSON mask file with area fraction and uncertain IoU filtering
